structure.description: 一张全幅主视觉填满画面，极少文字以高对比叠放或置于安全区域。

subject_rules.primary: make one full-bleed visual the entire slide; do not add dashboards, timelines, or matrices

visual_flow.primary: from full-screen visual to concise overlaid message

generation.style: one image, one message, high contrast type placement only where the visual permits
